newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Presidential spokesman and special envoy Traian Chebeleu to hand deliver in Athens President Ion Iliescu's message to Greek Prime Minister Costas Simitis, reiterating Romania's bid to join NATO.

Similar messages were already delievered to U.S. President Bill Clinton and Canadian Prime Minister Jean Chretien and will be sent to presidents of all NATO member countries as well as NATO Secretary General Javier Solana.
* International seminar on "Multi-dimensional Integration: The Regional Perspective" organised by New York-based Institute for East-West Studies opens in Bucharest.
* Bucharest International Fair opens with 700 Romanian companies exhibiting and 500 firms from 20 countries present. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
